title: Conformance matrix, Phase 5 (AMF: NGAP / N2, 5GMM / N1, NAS security, mobility, Namf services, persistence)
note: Same rules as the other matrices: every test reference, function and clause is checked by tools/check_matrix.py. verified = tests pass and a real peer confirms it (UERANSIM + Open5GS's AUSF / NRF with our AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM and PCF in scenarios S1-S4 with OUR_AMF=1). The scripted gNB and UE of the end-to-end suite derive every key independently of the AMF and run over real SCTP. The gap rows are what the phase leaves out.

rows.procedure: NG Setup: the gNB's supported TAs and broadcast PLMNs are checked against the AMF's; the answer carries the AMF name, served GUAMIs, relative capacity and the PLMN support list with the slices; unknown PLMN / unserved TAC give an NG Setup Failure with a cause and time to wait
rows.evidence: UERANSIM's gNB completes NG Setup against our AMF in every oracle scenario. The scripted gNB covers the refusals and checks every IE of the response.

rows.procedure: RAN Configuration Update: new supported TA list accepted when it intersects ours, refused with a cause otherwise
rows.evidence: Scripted gNB.

rows.procedure: NG Reset (whole interface and part of it): the UE contexts of the association are released and the reset acknowledged
rows.evidence: Scripted gNB: after the reset the UE is CM-IDLE and its session reference is kept.

rows.procedure: Error Indication for a message before NG Setup, for undecodable PDUs and for unknown / inconsistent UE-NGAP-IDs
rows.evidence: Scripted gNB; replay fuzzing with mutations under ASan/UBSan.

rows.procedure: Initial UE Message / Uplink NAS Transport / Downlink NAS Transport: routing by AMF-UE-NGAP-ID, user location (NR-CGI, TAI) taken from every message
rows.evidence: UERANSIM registers, establishes a session and de-registers through our AMF (S1-S4).

rows.procedure: Initial Context Setup: GUAMI, allowed NSSAI, UE security capabilities, KgNB, the registration / service accept and, for reactivated sessions, the PDU session resource setup list; response and failure handled
rows.evidence: UERANSIM's gNB accepts the setup and derives working AS keys from our KgNB; the scripted UE derives the same KgNB from KAMF and the uplink NAS COUNT.

rows.procedure: UE Context Release: gNB-initiated request (inactivity) and AMF-initiated command (de-registration, reject, abort), confirmed by the complete; guard timer when the gNB stays silent
rows.evidence: UERANSIM exercises the AMF-initiated release at de-registration; the scripted gNB covers the request and the missing complete.

rows.procedure: PDU Session Resource Setup / Modify / Release requests built from the SMF's N2 transfers, responses and failures reported back to the SMF
rows.evidence: S2/S3: the session is set up and released through Open5GS's SMF and ours; S4's policy push reaches the gNB as a Modify Request. The scripted gNB answers the modify (which UERANSIM does not).

rows.procedure: Paging: the UE's 5G-S-TMSI and the TAIs of its registration area per gNB, repeated every T3513 up to the configured number of attempts
rows.evidence: Scripted gNB: both pages arrive, the second after T3513.

rows.procedure: Path Switch Request (Xn handover): per-session switching at the SMF, fresh {NH, NCC} for the target gNB, acknowledge; failure for an unknown UE
rows.evidence: Two scripted gNBs; the next hop the AMF sends equals the one the UE side derives; the user plane then runs through gNB B.

rows.procedure: N2 handover: Handover Required, target selection by node id and TAI, Handover Request with security context and the SMF's setup transfer, Acknowledge, Command, Notify and release of the source; cancellation and target refusal
rows.evidence: Two scripted gNBs against the real SMF and UPF; the source leg is released with cause successful-handover and the user plane follows the target tunnel.

rows.procedure: UE radio capability and location reports stored / forwarded; NAS non-delivery indication counted
rows.evidence: The radio capability is returned in the next Initial Context Setup; location reports feed the event exposure.

rows.procedure: Initial registration: SUCI, authentication, NAS security mode control, UDM registration and subscription data, AM policy, slice selection, 5G-GUTI allocation, accept in the context setup, complete
rows.evidence: UERANSIM registers (SUCI null scheme) against our AMF with Open5GS's AUSF / UDM and with ours; the scripted UE checks every IE of the accept.

rows.procedure: Registration for mobility / periodic update on an established connection and with a stored context (no authentication when the integrity check passes)
rows.evidence: Scripted UE: protected request under the stored context needs neither authentication nor a security mode command; an update on an existing connection is answered in a DL NAS transport.

rows.procedure: Registration reject causes: #3/#5/#7/#12/#23/#62/#111 as the situation requires; the connection is released and a context that never registered is not kept
rows.evidence: Unknown subscriber (#7), emergency (#5), tracking area (#12, protected under the new context), no common algorithm (#23).

rows.procedure: Identification: identity request for an unknown 5G-GUTI, SUCI in the response, then authentication
rows.evidence: Scripted UE (unprotected request with a GUTI nobody knows).

rows.procedure: 5G-AKA authentication: challenge from the AUSF, HRES* checked by the AMF, confirmation at the AUSF, KAMF with ABBA; MAC failure, synchronisation failure (AUTS to the AUSF, new challenge) and wrong RES* handled; Authentication reject
rows.evidence: UERANSIM authenticates against our AMF + Open5GS's AUSF/UDM (S1) including the SQN resynchronisation of the golden capture; the scripted UE verifies AUTN, derives KAMF independently and drives the failure paths.

rows.procedure: NAS security mode control: algorithm selection by preference list (NIA2; NEA2 then NEA0), replayed capabilities, IMEISV request, RINMR for an unprotected initial message, complete with the NAS message container
rows.evidence: UERANSIM accepts the command with its replayed capabilities and answers with the ciphered complete; byte-exact SMC encoding in the unit test.

rows.procedure: NAS integrity protection and ciphering (NIA2 / NEA2), COUNT estimation across the 8-bit wrap, replay and MAC failure dropped
rows.evidence: Keys and counts agree with UERANSIM for the whole registration / session procedure; hostile messages are dropped without side effects.

rows.procedure: Service request: 5G-S-TMSI identification, integrity check, ciphered NAS message container with the uplink data status, service accept, reactivation of the sessions in the context setup; reject #9 for an unknown / unverified UE
rows.evidence: Scripted UE and gNB against the real SMF and UPF; the buffered downlink packet arrives at the new tunnel.

rows.procedure: Paging and mobile-terminated service request: the SMF's N1N2 transfer for an idle UE is answered 202, queued, delivered with the context setup
rows.evidence: Scripted: downlink data from the data network triggers the report, the SMF's transfer, the pages and the delivery; unanswered paging reports a failure to the SMF's URI.

rows.procedure: UE-originated de-registration (normal and switch off): sessions released at the SMF, UDM / PCF cleaned, accept, context release
rows.evidence: S1-S4 de-register UERANSIM's UE; the scripted UE covers switch off.

rows.procedure: Network-initiated de-registration with re-registration required (T3522), also towards an idle UE after paging; local de-registration when it cannot be reached
rows.evidence: Scripted UE.

rows.procedure: Generic UE configuration update: new 5G-GUTI with acknowledgement (T3555), TAI list, allowed NSSAI, network names; pending until the UE is reachable
rows.evidence: Scripted UE.

rows.procedure: 5G-GUTI: AMF identity, 5G-TMSI uniqueness, reallocation at every registration, old GUTI invalid after completion
rows.evidence: Byte-exact GUTI and TAI list encodings; the old 5G-TMSI is rejected with #9.

rows.procedure: Retransmission timers T3550 / T3560 / T3570 / T3555 / T3522: four retransmissions then abort; implicit de-registration after T3512 + grace
rows.evidence: Counted at the scripted gNB; the abort releases the connection and drops a context that never registered.

rows.procedure: UL / DL NAS transport of 5GSM messages: routing by PDU session id, request type, S-NSSAI and DNN (default DNN), slice check against the allowed NSSAI, other payload types refused with #90
rows.evidence: UERANSIM's sessions (S2/S3); the scripted UE checks the #90 answer for a slice outside the allowed NSSAI.

rows.procedure: PDU session status and uplink data status in registration and service request: sessions the UE does not hold are released at the SMF, reactivation result returned
rows.evidence: Scripted UE.

rows.procedure: Slice selection: requested NSSAI intersected with the subscription and the AMF's slices, rejected NSSAI with cause, default S-NSSAIs when nothing was requested, #62 when nothing remains
rows.evidence: Scripted UE (slice 1 allowed); the rejected NSSAI IE is byte-checked.

rows.procedure: Nausf_UEAuthentication client: start with SUCI / SUPI and optional resynchronisation info, 5G-AKA confirmation with RES*
rows.evidence: Open5GS's AUSF (S1-S4) and our AUSF shim (e2e).

rows.procedure: Nudm_UECM registration / de-registration of the AMF (3GPP access) with the de-registration callback, Nudm_SDM access and mobility subscription data (subscribed UE-AMBR and NSSAI) and subscription
rows.evidence: Against Open5GS's UDM and ours; Open5GS's UDM refuses the UECM DELETE (answered 403), which the AMF tolerates.

rows.procedure: Npcf_AMPolicyControl create / delete of the policy association with the notification URIs
rows.evidence: Open5GS's PCF (after the NrLocation fix found by the oracle run) and ours.

rows.procedure: Nsmf_PDUSession create / update / release SM context towards the SMF, multipart bodies, SM context status callback
rows.evidence: S2-S4 with Open5GS's SMF and with ours.

rows.procedure: Namf_Communication N1N2MessageTransfer: N1 only, N2 setup / modify / release, with and without N1; 200 delivered, 202 attempting to reach the UE, failure notification URI; unknown UE 404, bad bodies 400, unsupported N2 type 501
rows.evidence: Open5GS's SMF and ours.

rows.procedure: Namf_EventExposure: subscriptions for registration state, connectivity state, reachability and location (one UE or any), notifications, delete, immediate report; unsupported events 501
rows.evidence: Scripted subscriber.

rows.procedure: NF discovery through the NRF for AUSF / UDM / PCF / SMF (by service, S-NSSAI, DNN) with a one minute cache; configured URIs take precedence
rows.evidence: Open5GS's NRF finds the SMF, AUSF and our UDM / PCF (oracle S2-S4); the AMF registers with an amfInfo profile.

rows.procedure: UE context persistence: registered contexts (GUTI, security context, NSSAI, session references) in an atomically written state file, restored in CM-IDLE; downlink NAS COUNT kept above the UE's expectation
rows.evidence: The AMF is stopped and started; the UE's service request is served without authentication and the session's user plane comes back.

rows.procedure: Configuration: strict keys, ranges, SNOW 3G / ZUC refused by name (ADR-0012), NRF profile with amfInfo
rows.evidence: Negative cases name the setting; the sample configuration loads through `amf --check`.

rows.procedure: Concurrency: per-connection ordering, per-UE mutual exclusion, no data races in the whole end-to-end suite
rows.evidence: The e2e suite passes under ThreadSanitizer and AddressSanitizer / UBSan (scripts/g5c_regress.sh).

rows.procedure: Hostile NGAP PDUs, NAS under a valid envelope and SBI bodies never crash or leak
rows.evidence: Replay fuzzing with mutations under ASan/UBSan: golden NGAP PDUs raw and with the NAS wrapped in a protected envelope, plus SBI bodies for every route.

rows.procedure: Metrics: NG Setup, NGAP and NAS message counts, registrations, authentications, service requests, pagings, handovers, N1N2 transfers, PDU session requests, registered / connected UE and gNB gauges
rows.evidence: Registered with the shared registry.

rows.procedure: SNOW 3G (NEA1 / NIA1) and ZUC (NEA3 / NIA3): not selected, not advertised (a UE offering only these is rejected with #23)
rows.evidence: ADR-0012: the algorithms are not implemented until the owner signs the ETSI/SAGE licence; no unlicensed implementation exists in the tree.

rows.procedure: Emergency registration and services, MICO, extended DRX, NB-IoT / CIoT, SMS over NAS, UE policy delivery (UCU), SOR, NSSAA
rows.evidence: Emergency registration is rejected with #5; the other features are not signalled.

rows.procedure: AMF sets and relocation: Namf_Communication UEContextTransfer / CreateUEContext, AMF status indication, GUAMI backup, inter-AMF handover and registration with a GUTI of another AMF (answered with an identity request)
rows.evidence: Single AMF per PLMN; the state file is the first step towards externalised contexts (a shared store is not built).

rows.procedure: Non-3GPP access (N3IWF), EPS interworking (N26) and handover to E-UTRAN, LADN, network slice selection through the NSSF
rows.evidence: Single access type (NR); slices come from configuration and the UDM.
